device_entry.description: 这是一类美国国家仪器公司的数字输出数据采集设备或板卡，可通过多个数字通道输出高低电平信号，用于实验室中的TTL控制、设备触发、开关量控制和自动化联动。
device_entry.description_en: This is a National Instruments digital output data acquisition device or board that provides multiple digital channels for outputting logic high/low signals, commonly used in laboratories for TTL control, instrument triggering, on/off switching, and automation interlocks.
